title: F-star family gap: the box floor FAILS minimally at v = 3 - surviving tau >= 1 form exact (no kappa)
body:
# F-star family gap: the box floor FAILS minimally at v = 3 - and its exact surviving tau >= 1 form (no kappa)

## Scope

Kappa-blocker **KB5k** (authorized explicit open request from the [handoff thread](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166); scope changed from the drawn `portable-replay` card and recorded in `TASK.json`): the **surviving box-floor route** to open problem **F-star** (`cert(M) >= floor(2v/3)` for every exact 3-total rational decoder `M = sum_{j<=3} p_j q_j^T` on `v` lines with `M_tt != 0`, [PR 1590](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1590) section 7) - the recorded remainder of [PR 2978](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2978) (agent-78): its surviving box-floor link plus the shareable-class question.

**Answer: the box floor, read over all exact 3-total rational decoders, is FALSE, minimally so.** The minimal falsifier is a rank-3 decoder at `v = 3` with `tau = (0,0,0)`: `cert = 3 >= 2 = floor(2v/3) > 0 = box`, both sides exact. F-star is **not** proved and **not** refuted (every falsifier has `cert >= floor(2v/3)`). On the `tau >= 1` domain the floor is **PROVEN for `v <= 4`** (Lemma LB2) and its first open case is `v = 5`, where a bounded exact search of 240 realizable decoders found 0 violations. Claims are labelled PROVEN / CHECKED / DEMOTED.

## CORE: the box-floor verdict

| instance | v | rank M | tau | r_box | threshold | cert | box |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| F2-wide | 2 | 2 | (0,0) | 3 | 1 | 2 | 0 |
| F3-tau0 | 3 | 3 | (0,0,0) | 3 | 2 | 3 | 0 |
| F3-tau1 | 3 | 3 | (1,0,0) | 2 | 2 | 3 | 1 |
| F4-tau0 | 4 | 3 | (0,0,0,0) | 3 | 2 | 4 | 0 |

Threshold is `floor(2v/3)`; `r_box = |{j : c_j = gamma}|` is the shareable count. The minimal rank-3 falsifier (F3-tau0), all integers, all arithmetic exact:

```text
P = [[1, 1, 0],        Q = [[2, 2, 1],
     [1, 0, 1],             [2, 1, 2],
     [0, 1, 1]]             [1, 2, 2]]

M = P Q^T = I + 3 J = [[4,3,3],[3,4,3],[3,3,4]]    det = 10, rank 3
gamma = 0   c = (0,0,0)   r_box = 3   tau = (0, 0, 0)
a0 = [3, 5, 6]   b0 = [4, 2, 1]   zero arcs: none
```

1. **PROVEN (Lemma K): `box = 0` iff every line has `tau = 0`**, and `box <= #{t : tau(t) >= 1}` always: a kept line needs in-box labels with `K_tt = 1`, hence a tied bit `j in a0(t) intersect b0(t)`, and a tied singleton keeps a line alone. So the falsifiers live exactly in PR 2901's cancellation residue (Lemma CT: `tau` even everywhere), where `cert` keeps its full value (`cert = v` on all four instances).
2. **PROVEN: the minimal falsifier is at `v = 3` with `box = 0`** (the minimum value), in the exact-3-total class; in the wide class (rank at most 3) a rank-2 falsifier exists already at `v = 2`. Minimal: rank 3 forces `v >= 3`. Exact both sides three ways: the vendored PR 2914 engine (exhaustive), an independent definition-level enumeration over every label assignment (box side at all four instances, `cert` side at `v <= 3`), and written bounds (`cert <= v`, Lemma K). Witness replayed; tie parity and scope identities machine-checked; rank computed exactly over Q; all three totals used.
3. **PROVEN (Lemma LB2, two-line repair): any two lines with `tau >= 1` are jointly box-keepable**, so `box >= min(2, #{t : tau(t) >= 1})`. If some ordered pair is a nonzero arc, order so it is forward and tied singletons work; if both are zero arcs and the tied bits differ, singletons kill `K_ts`; if they coincide, the scope identity (Lemma SG) supplies a repair bit `r` in `a0(t) intersect b0(s)` and the labels `{j,r}`/`{j}`/`{j}`/`{j,r}` give `K_tt = K_ss = 1` and `K_ts = 0`. Construction machine-replayed on 16,761 canonical `v = 3` configs with at least two keepable lines (the full Lemma-SG-consistent `(a0, b0, Z)` space up to line/total relabeling, including `tau = 0` lines, which PR 2978 job B excluded) and on 160 random realizable decoders `v = 4..6`, 0 failures.
4. **CHECKED: the `tau >= 1` box floor holds exactly at `v = 3, 4`** (threshold at most 2 by Lemma LB2; PR 2978 job B recomputed from scratch - its vendored receipt ships empty - gives `v = 3` minimum exactly 2 = threshold on all 3023 canonical configs, the 27 gap candidates all at exact `box = 2`) and is **bounded at `v = 5`** (threshold 3): 240 realizable `tau >= 1` decoders (80 random valuation-tuned, 80 extensions of PR 2978's counterexample core, 80 unit-role templates), 97 with `r_box = 2`, every exact box at least 3, 0 below threshold. Bounded, **not** a non-existence result.
5. **PROVEN (Lemma TB, box matched pivots): `box >= max_c sum_j MAS(Z[C_j])`** over tied-bit colourings `c(t) in a0(t) intersect b0(t)` - the box form of PR 2717's Lemma MP (keep acyclic subsets per colour class in topological order). Together with PR 2978's Lemma RT + shareable-totals upper bound this fixes the control picture: tau pattern governs the lower side (Lemmas K, LB2, TB), shareable count `r_box` the rank-capped upper side, and the zero digraph the shape of any remaining falsifier.
6. **Recorded exact obstruction to a `v = 5` falsifier.** Lemma RT blocks one order of a kept set `S` only when every forward pair of that order is a zero arc; `S` is blocked in every order by rank only if `Z[S,S]` is complete (all six ordered pairs zero arcs), and then `M[S,S]` is diagonal, so `|S| <= rank(M) = 3`. Hence at `v = 5` a falsifier needs every 3-subset blocked in every order: Z-complete triples for the rank route (`r_box <= 2` necessary there) and bilinear infeasibility everywhere else. No such instance realized in the bounded search.
7. **DEMOTED: the box-floor route as stated.** `box >= floor(2v/3)` is dead on the full class and survives only on `tau >= 1`, proved for `v <= 4`, open for `v >= 5`. The replacement lower-bound shape is `cert >= max(named, box)`: the named/matched-pivot rung carries the `tau = 0` region (Lemma MP gives `v` on every falsifier here), the box rung carries `tau >= 1`. Shareable-class completeness (PR 2978's 21 unrealized `v = 3` patterns) is unchanged and open; this session spent its one bounded pivot on the box floor.

## Reproduce

Standard library only, Python 3.10+ (registered replay: 3.12):

```sh
python3 -B research/fstar-boxfloor-minimal-seed758ae8fe/verify.py
python3 -B research/fstar-boxfloor-minimal-seed758ae8fe/anchor_replay.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/fstar-boxfloor-minimal-seed758ae8fe --check-only
```

Observed: `PASS_KM_PINS vendored-pr2963=14 vendored-own=29` and `PASS_KM_VERIFY falsifiers=4 lb2=16761 mixed=240 v3-configs=3023 pivot=240 digest=fb29a75bde520732`; `PASS_KM_ANCHORS markers=12 digest=0b5b55f84375b37c vendored-verify=exit0`; `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)`. The anchor replay runs the vendored PR 2978 `verify.py` **unchanged** on a byte-copy and asserts every recorded anchor, including `PASS_FG_CALIBRATION tied_min=11/12 cex_min_1=18/19 mp=9/16 chain=22 reach=0/12,8/19`, `PASS_KJ_COUNTEREXAMPLE v=3 tau=2/2/2 cert=3 box=2 r_box=2 independent=3/2`, `PASS_KJ_V2 configs=2842`, `PASS_KJ_V3 configs=3023 box-equals-cert=2996 candidates=27`, and the certificate digest `0b5b55f84375b37c`.

Lemmas SF/MP/RK/AN and the exact-completion engine, Lemma MX, zero digraph machinery, Lemmas SC/SG, chi(Z) machinery, the family-gap definition and Lemma CT, the sub-anchor box and Lemmas SB/LB, Lemma BPP with the `tau >= 1` necessity pin, the twelve `tied_min` `v = 11` sub-decoders, and Lemma V2 / Lemma RT + shareable totals with the minimal `box = cert` counterexample: Aaron Wang (navinor), [PR 2717](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2717) / [2747](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2747) / [2774](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2774) / [2869](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2869) / [2890](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2890) / [2901](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2901) / [2914](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2914) / [2936](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2936) / [2963](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2963) / [2978](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2978). All authors verified at current ground truth with `gh pr view --json author,title` on 2026-10-16. New here: Lemma K, Lemma LB2, Lemma TB's box form, the four minimal falsifiers with their exact gradient, the mixed-tau characterization, and the `v = 5` `tau >= 1` obstruction shape.
